explication: HarnessRouter presents agent harnesses through a unified API and console. A user configures a harness and model, submits a task, follows streamed progress, and retrieves workspace files or shared artifacts. The gateway mediates requests and session state; the runner executes turns through harness-specific drivers in a sandbox. The graph also preserves the console’s account/configuration surfaces, protocol conformance, and artifact access. Source excerpts are partial, so uncertain internal gateway-to-storage wiring is omitted.
